title: A $1.5 billion crypto startup is taking on Hyperliquid with a Wall Street playbook
content: Variational and its investors are betting that the future of onchain trading will look more like a traditional brokerage than a crypto exchange.

title: Crypto Long & Short: Crypto exchanges shouldn’t double as the vault
content: A single breach moved billions out of Binance in minutes, exposing how much client money sits with the venue that trades it. Darren Jordan of Komainu argues institutions should keep trading and custody separate, as traditional markets have for decades, and sets out the questions to ask about where assets are held.

title: German judge proposes dropping Movie2k case if operator hands over $2.56 billion in bitcoin
content: Prosecutors estimate the defendant still holds 56,000 BTC, meaning the proposed deal would leave him with roughly $1 billion.

title: Hong Kong wants banks to use AI to catch crypto crime before money disappears
content: As Hong Kong pushes banks to use AI to combat crypto crime, experts say the technology must detect suspicious transfers without putting customer funds at risk.

title: Bitcoin miner MARA raises $185 million in debt after selling $1 billion BTC to repay loans
content: The bitcoin miner is taking on borrowing tied to an Ohio power plant as it shifts more of its business toward AI infrastructure.

title: $25M Ethereum MEV acquittal tests criminal enforcement limits
content: BlackRock’s staked Ether ETF earns a cut of what traders pay for priority on Ethereum, the acquittal left the legal risk to that income unresolved.

title: Polymarket US takes rapid-fire crypto trading format to oil, natural gas
content: Polymarket US said it attracted more than 300,000 traders to its short-duration crypto markets in six weeks and is now expanding the format to energy commodities.

title: Bitcoin, stocks wobble as Fed’s Waller talks of ‘shock’ 50-point rate hike
content: Bitcoin price action dropped below $63,000 after fresh hawkish comments from the Fed as Nvidia earnings optimism faded.

title: Bitcoin Covenants Part 6: FE Covenants — Enforcing covenants through cryptographically restricted signing keys
content: FE covenants encode spending constraints into the signing key, so only transactions that satisfy a predefined condition can be signed.

title: CoinShares sells all treasury ETH, halves SOL holdings for buybacks
content: The October sales raised $19.3 million, nearly half the $40 million CoinShares can spend on buybacks before its next annual meeting.

title: Lucky Trader Banks 66,000% Profit on GTA 6 Meme Coin Ticker Confusion
content: The trader turned $300 into over $200,000 as early footage of GTA 6 sent degens flocking between different token tickers.

title: 'It Speaks in Tongues That Only 6.2 Astra Understands': Why Early Testers Hate OpenAI’s New Model
content: OpenAI's flagship AI model is dazzling developers with 3D creations, but early testers say it stalls during long projects, gives baffling explanations, and hides failures.

title: Movie2K Defendant Could Hand Over 40,000 Bitcoin to End Trial—and Stay a Billionaire
content: A German judge has offered to drop the charges if the alleged operator of the piracy site gives up most of his remaining Bitcoin.

title: Morning Minute: Nvidia Beats, Board Says ‘No’ on Jensen
content: Nvidia delivered its best earnings ever and raised forward guidance. And yet, the market mostly shrugged. What does it mean?

title: 'Doomed From the Start': President Trump's Meme Coin Hits New Lows After Midterms
content: The TRUMP token has fallen almost 40% since election day, with analysts pointing to the Democrats’ subpoena plans, fading interest, and a heavy unlock schedule.

title: Analyst: Bitcoin Below $70,000 is a ‘Gift From the Market’
content: Bitcoin Magazine Analyst: Bitcoin Below $70,000 is a ‘Gift From the Market’ K33 Research said bitcoin is in "deep value territory" after a 14% weekly drop, as ETF outflows, liquidations and hedging demand reach levels seen near past bottoms. title: Ionic Digital (IOND) Sells 737 Bitcoin to Fund Data Center Buildout
content: Bitcoin Magazine Ionic Digital (IOND) Sells 737 Bitcoin to Fund Data Center Buildout Ionic Digital sold about 737 bitcoin for roughly $61.6 million after Sept. 30 and plans to use the cash to develop its data center sites, its latest quarterly report shows. This post Ionic Digital (IOND) Sells 737 Bitcoin to Fund Data Center Buildout first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: German Court Offers to Drop Movie2k Case for 40,000 Bitcoin
content: Bitcoin Magazine German Court Offers to Drop Movie2k Case for 40,000 Bitcoin A Leipzig judge has offered to dismiss the Movie2k criminal case if the defendant hands over 40,000 bitcoin, which would leave him about 16,000 coins worth roughly $1.02 billion. This post German Court Offers to Drop Movie2k Case for 40,000 Bitcoin first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Coinbase Says Its AI Blocked $4.7 Million in Deepfake Elon Musk Scam
content: Bitcoin Magazine Coinbase Says Its AI Blocked $4.7 Million in Deepfake Elon Musk Scam Coinbase said its AI scam-prevention agent stopped about $4.7 million, roughly 91% of what customers tried to send, from reaching scammers running a deepfake Elon Musk crypto giveaway. This post Coinbase Says Its AI Blocked $4.7 Million in Deepfake Elon Musk Scam first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: New York State Pension Fund Boosts Strategy (MSTR) Stake by More Than 10%
content: Bitcoin Magazine New York State Pension Fund Boosts Strategy (MSTR) Stake by More Than 10% New York's state pension fund raised its Strategy (MSTR) stake to 352,850 shares worth $54.0 million at Sept. 30, a gain of more than 10% from June 30, its latest 13F shows. This post New York State Pension Fund Boosts Strategy (MSTR) Stake by More Than 10% first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
